# OpenJev thinking measurement (v1.2.13)

This addition uses the unchanged frozen 534-decision JevBench v1.2 set and scorer.
Unlike the experimental djev full-generation row, OpenJev exposes a real typed
API switch: `think` accepts 0–4096 tokens. The frozen configuration was:

- `razorback16/openjev` revision `2d20174`;
- BF16 `google/diffusiongemma-26b-a4b-it` on one lium.io H200;
- native `/v1/systemone` requests with `think=512`;
- serial execution, one request at a time.

OpenJev generates the thought first and then performs native probability reads
conditioned on it. All 534 attempts returned valid distributions. Cost counts
the server-reported billed input and thought output tokens for every decision at
a same-size public hosted reference tariff; the row also reports the measured
serial H200 rental equivalent as sensitivity.

No earlier answer, task, score, or methodology changed.
